detail.title: 4MP High Temperature Tolerance WizMind Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-HFS8449G-Z7-LED 4MP High Temperature Tolerance WizMind Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4 MP Resolution • 8-56mm Motorized Vari-focal Lens • Intelligent Temperature Control System Automates Operation in High-temperature Zones • Works 24/7 in a 75°C (167°F) environment and for 12-hour periods in 85°C (185°F) • 5 Streams for Diverse Application Needs • Supports 5 AI Functions, Applicable for Multi-scenario Targets Detection and Analysis • Advanced Technologies: Time-Division Exposure, Ghosting Diminishment, and Hyper DoF, Ensure Superior Image Quality • IP67 Protection, Suitable for Outdoor Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 0.0003 lux@F1.2(Color, 30 IRE) 0.0001 lux@F1.2 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire, fast moving (the three functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human); loitering detection, people gathering, and parking detection
General.Face Detection: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting.
General.Face Recognition: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (recognition priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting. Supports adding 5 group face databases; registering person one by one or in batches; setting face similarity; and supports face comparison with the face database containing up to 100,000 face pictures.
General.People Counting: Tripwire people counting and people counting in area, generating and exporting report (day/month/year); queue management, generating and exporting report (day/month); 4 rules can be set for tripwire, people counting in area and queue management
General.Video Metadata: Motor vehicle, non-motor vehicle, face, and human body detection; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload. Motor vehicle attributes: License plate, plate color, vehicle color, vehicle logo, vehicle year, sun visor, seatbelt, smoking, calling, ornament, and annual inspection sticker and more. Non-motor vehicle attributes: Type, vehicle color, number of people, top type and color, and hat. Human body attributes: Top and bottom type and color, bag, hat, and gender. Face attributes: Gender, age, expressions, glasses, face mask, and bread.
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by the sub stream)
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–10240 kbps; H.265: 12 kbps–9472 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; loitering detection; people gathering; parking detection; scene changing; audio detection; voltage detection; defocus detection; external alarm; face detection; face recognition; people counting in area; people counting; people number error detection; security exception
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; SAMBA; PPPoE; SNMP
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S/Profile G/Profile T); CGI; Milestone
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 256 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE: IE 11 and earlier; Chrome: 88.0.4324.190 and earlier; Firefox: 47.0.2 and earlier
General.Cyber Security: Configuration encryption;trusted execution; Digest; security logs; WSSE; account lockout; syslog; video encryption; 802.1x; IP/MAC filtering; HTTPS; trusted upgrade; trusted boot; firmware encryption; generation and importing of X.509 certification
General.Certifications: CE-LVD:EN62368-1; CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU; FCC:47 CFR FCC Part 15, Subpart B
General.Alarm Output: 2 channels out: 1,000 mA 30 VDC/500 mA 50 VAC
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 22.5 W (220 V) Max. (Basic+ WDR+ Intelligence on + Illuminator on + Lens switching): 26 W (220 V)
